QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_35

question.text: Under SAS-400, the 'LGBTQIA+ inclusion' indicator in workplace programmes requires reporting:

answer.text: The sexual orientation of every employee
Aggregate, anonymised self-identification of LGBTQIA+ employees with explicit opt-in consent, plus policy-level indicators (anti-discrimination policy, benefits parity, ERG support)

explanation.text: The Logic: Aggregated self-identification with opt-in consent preserves privacy while enabling measurement. Policy-level indicators (anti-discrimination, benefits, ERG) complete the picture. SAS-400 requires BOTH employee-metric AND policy-environment indicators. The Trap: Option A violates privacy. Option B is not evidence. Option D omits the metric. Cross-Exam Context: Aligned with DPDP Act privacy and SEBI BRSR diversity disclosure in III-A / III-C Compliance. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Never demand full personal-identifier disclosure — use opt-in anonymous self-ID with a secure collection method. Report aggregates only (min cell-size 5) to prevent re-identification.
